_comment: Schema for agent profile JSON. The mindserver validates against this and the dashboard generates the profile editor from it, so a new profile key gets UI by adding a row here. Sections group fields in the editor; 'advanced' fields are collapsed by default.

name.description: The bot's Minecraft username. 3-16 characters, letters/numbers/underscore.

model.description: Chat model. Either "provider/model" or an object {api, model, url, params}.

code_model.description: Model for writing code (!newAction). Defaults to the chat model.

vision_model.description: Model for image analysis. Defaults to the chat model.

embedding.description: Embedding model for memory/skill/example retrieval. Keep local if you can.

max_tokens.description: Legacy per-response token cap; prefer model.params.

tiers.description: Per-tier model overrides. Omit to send every tier to the chat model.

reflex.description: Cheap, frequent calls: bot responder, skill docstrings. Keep local.

chat.description: Conversation and autonomous step prompting — the bulk of traffic. Keep local.

plan.description: Goal generation and task planning. A mid-tier API model earns its keep here.

reflect.description: Reflection and pivotal judgements. The only tier worth a frontier model.

drives.description: Intrinsic drives. Weight scales urgency; decay is per minute for non-sensor drives.

weight.description: How much this drive matters to this personality.

decay_per_min.description: How fast it builds up when unsatisfied (decay drives only).

description.description: Shown to the model when it generates a goal for this drive.

social.description: How this personality forms and keeps relationships.

trust_loss.description: How readily trust is lost. Above 1 is suspicious.

gossip_propensity.description: Likelihood of passing on news about others.

generosity.description: Willingness to give and to accept lopsided trades.

min_urgency.description: Urgency needed before the agent invents a goal at all.

switch_margin.description: How much a rival drive must beat the current one to take over.

heartbeat_ms.description: How long to wait with nothing happening before re-examining the plan.

step_cooldown_ms.description: Settle time after an event before prompting.

step_timeout_ms.description: Active time a single step may consume before it counts as failed.

half_life_hours.description: How fast recency fades in retrieval scoring.

reflection_threshold.description: Accumulated importance before the agent reflects.

max_events_in_ram.description: Events held in memory (all are still written to disk).

direct_execute_cosine.description: Embedding similarity needed to rerun a stored skill instead of writing new code.

max_compose_depth.description: How deep learned skills may call each other.

self_preservation.description: React to fire, lava, drowning, and lethal damage.

unstuck.description: Break out of being stuck in one place.

cheat.description: Use commands to place blocks and teleport instantly.

conversing.description: System prompt for conversation and autonomous steps.

goal_generation.description: Prompt that turns drive state into a goal.

task_planning.description: Prompt that breaks a goal into steps.

reflecting.description: Prompt that turns events into durable beliefs.

skill_docstring.description: Prompt that describes a newly learned skill.

bot_responder.description: Prompt deciding whether to answer another bot now.
